_meta.policy_name: Classic Vending Operator Balance Overlay v1
_meta.authorization: User authorized a validated operator tool for Small/Medium category and rarity tuning on 2026-08-20.
_meta.boundary: Recovered summon_pool_catalog.json stays immutable evidence. This overlay only changes private-server selection when the corresponding override is enabled.
guardrails: Small x10 item-class guarantee and Medium x10 full-Girl guarantee remain unchanged.
Medium featured-only New Add overlay remains separate and is evaluated before ordinary category selection.
Scroll classification is explicit: an item row is a Girl scroll only when its item_id equals partner.stone_id in the effective GameDataCatalog.
When explicit Scroll category tuning is enabled, scroll candidates are split flat/equally across all eligible scroll rows in the configured base pool.
Girl rarity tuning selects native partner.ini_star 1/2/3 first, then preserves source/extension row weighting within the selected star bucket.

category_override.note: Disabled by default to preserve the exact pre-Pass42.12 two-stage Small math. Values are a rounded display baseline only until enabled.

girl_star_override.note: Small pool151001 currently contains only native-1-star Girls. Nonzero 2/3-star weights are invalid.

category_override.note: These values exactly match the current ordinary non-special Medium class split implied by 200003 rate_sum=8560 plus 14.40% Hero selection. Disabled means legacy two-stage math is used.

girl_star_override.note: Rounded display baseline for the effective 143-Girl weighted pool (source rows plus 58 extensions). Disabled preserves exact source/extension candidate weights.
